title: Làdavas 2001 · single-case auditory–tactile extinction
citation: Làdavas, E., Pavani, F., & Farnè, A. (2001). Auditory peripersonal space in humans: a case of auditory-tactile extinction. Neurocase, 7(2), 97–103.
notes: Published study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

published_method.cohort: One right-hemisphere injury case with preserved unilateral touch and left tactile extinction. The related 2002 group report may include the same patient; independent sessions are not established by matching case details.
published_method.stimulus: Manual contact under one second gates the white-noise burst or 1500 Hz tone at 70 dB SPL measured at the ear. The simultaneous cross-modal target is contact on the left lateral neck.
published_method.response: Say which side was perceived immediately after stimulation, regardless of modality, or report neither. Compare left-touch detection against the within-block touch-only trials.

stimulus_type.source: Neurocase pp. 98–100, Materials and methods and Fig. 2

source_provenance.value: Live speaker output enabled by an optically isolated contact circuit and remote switch.
source_provenance.source: Làdavas et al. (2001), Neurocase 7(2), pp. 98–100, Materials and methods

trajectory_count.source: Làdavas et al. (2001), Neurocase 7(2), p. 99, Fig. 2 and surrounding Methods
trajectory_count.gap: Fixed loudspeaker positions with equalized levels.

trajectory_path.source: Làdavas et al. (2001), Neurocase 7(2), p. 99, Fig. 2 and surrounding Methods
trajectory_path.gap: Fixed loudspeaker positions with equalized levels.

stimulus_duration.value: Brief manual contact, under 1 s. Sound lasts only while contact closes the circuit and the switch permits emission.
stimulus_duration.source: Làdavas et al. (2001), Neurocase 7(2), pp. 98–100, Materials and methods
stimulus_duration.gap: No programmed exact pulse duration or distribution.

stimulus_speed.source: Làdavas et al. (2001), Neurocase 7(2), p. 99, Fig. 2 and surrounding Methods
stimulus_speed.gap: Fixed loudspeaker positions with equalized levels.

auditory_conditions.source: Neurocase pp. 98–100, Materials and methods and Fig. 2

gain_envelope.source: Làdavas et al. (2001), Neurocase 7(2), p. 99, Fig. 2 and surrounding Methods
gain_envelope.gap: Fixed loudspeaker positions with equalized levels.

renderer_or_apparatus.value: One 0.3 W, 8 Ω loudspeaker repositioned at ear level on a metal stand. White-noise bursts or a 1,500 Hz pure tone at 70 dB SPL at the participant's ear.
renderer_or_apparatus.source: Neurocase pp. 98–100, Materials and methods and Fig. 2

crossmodal: Left neck touch with simultaneous right sound

trial_rows_families.source: Neurocase pp. 98–100, Materials and methods and Fig. 2

condition_intermixing.value: The nine conditions are blocked. The four families are randomized within each block.
condition_intermixing.source: Neurocase pp. 98–100, Materials and methods and Fig. 2

blocked_or_random_order.value: Trials randomized within each condition block. Block order randomized between sessions.
blocked_or_random_order.source: Neurocase pp. 98–100, Materials and methods and Fig. 2

iti_jitter_policy.source: Làdavas et al. (2001), Neurocase 7(2), pp. 98–100, Materials and methods
iti_jitter_policy.gap: The full indexed Materials and methods do not report this setting.

response_window.value: Immediate verbal response. Prompt if absent.
response_window.source: Làdavas et al. (2001), Neurocase 7(2), pp. 98–100, Materials and methods
response_window.gap: No timeout in milliseconds is given.

task_sequence_rules.value: Name the perceived side or absence immediately after stimulation, regardless of modality. Prompt if no spontaneous answer. A second experimenter records each answer.
task_sequence_rules.source: Neurocase pp. 98–100, Materials and methods and Fig. 2

tactile_stimulus.value: Light contact with a 1 cm² touch-sensitive sensor just below the mastoid behind the ear. In the tactile-only condition a matching sensor is also attached to the right index finger of the experimenter.
tactile_stimulus.source: Neurocase pp. 98–100, Materials and methods and Fig. 2

soa_table.source: Neurocase pp. 98–100, Materials and methods and Fig. 2
soa_table.gap: The contact triggers sound. No measured onset lag or acoustic arrival timing.

value.unimodal_tactile_block: One block per session, sensor inactive. Equal left-only, right-only, bilateral and blank trials.
value.crossmodal_comparator: Left-touch-only trials embedded in each cross-modal block, compared with simultaneous left touch and right sound.

baseline_strategy.source: Neurocase pp. 98–100, Materials and methods and Fig. 2

baseline_timing.value: Left-touch-only comparator uses the same manual-contact procedure with no sound.
baseline_timing.source: Làdavas et al. (2001), Neurocase 7(2), pp. 98–100, Materials and methods
baseline_timing.gap: Measured contact times and intertrial intervals are unavailable.

catch_trial_type.value: No stimulus. In tactile-only blocks no touch is applied. In cross-modal blocks neither touch nor sound is presented.
catch_trial_type.source: Neurocase pp. 98–100, Materials and methods and Fig. 2

repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.value: 10 presentations per trial family per block, across three sessions.
repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.source: Neurocase pp. 98–100, Materials and methods and Fig. 2

baseline_count.source: Neurocase pp. 98–100, Materials and methods and Fig. 2
baseline_count.gap: 3 × 40 for tactile-only blocks, 3 × 30 for their stimulus trials, and 3 × 8 × 10 for matched touch-only trials.

catch_count.source: Neurocase pp. 98–100, Materials and methods and Fig. 2

block_count.source: Neurocase pp. 98–100, Materials and methods and Fig. 2

total_trial_count.source: Neurocase pp. 98–100, Materials and methods and Fig. 2

implementation_gaps: This clinical procedure requires a participant with the study-defined extinction pattern, an experimenter-held neck contact sensor, physical speaker calibration and independent verbal response coding.
The precise contact waveform and duration, sound waveform and acoustic onset, original randomization and trial interval are unavailable.
reference_parameters.planner_scope: The study settings describe the source procedure. The Planner contains no executable trial schedule for this profile.

provenance.source: https://doi.org/10.1093/neucas/7.2.97. Neurocase pp. 98–100, Materials and methods and Fig. 2; Neurocase pp. 99–100, Fig. 2 and Results
